purpose: Teach: 真夜中/どっと/あげく/大金/居間/つぶやい/しつこい/うろうろ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、真夜中の閉店作業、お疲れさま、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, thank you for closing up so late tonight.
lines.style: Warm, genuine gratitude. Soft opening, no performance. Holds the appreciation steady without making it awkward. Quiet confidence that Aoi will accept the thanks.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、開店後にお客様がどっと押し寄せたわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It was such a rush after we opened, wasn't it?
lines.style: Bright but slightly breathless, like the rush is still in her body. Quick pace on the describing part, then settles. Shared exhaustion — comfortable complicity.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、忙しかったあげく、最後はゆっくりできたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: We were slammed, but at least the end was peaceful.
lines.style: Dry, observational. The irony is light — she's not complaining, just noticing. Slight smile in the voice. Pace settles on 'peaceful' like a small relief.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様が大金を落としていかれて困ったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer left behind a stack of cash, which was its own kind of problem.
lines.style: Bemused, caught between amusement and concern. The absurdity of the situation carries the tone. Not rushed — she's enjoying the strangeness of it slightly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の居間風スペース、お客様お気に入りよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The living-room feel you created here — customers really do seem to love it.
lines.style: Genuine praise, without flattery. She's noticing something real. Warm but steady. No sugar-coating, just honest observation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様が「おいしい」とつぶやいてくれたわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer whispered 'delicious' to themselves just now.
lines.style: Tender, almost reverent. The smallness of the moment makes her voice smaller. Pace is gentle, letting the quiet gesture linger. She's treasuring this.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、しつこい営業電話に困ってるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've been getting hit with persistent sales calls all night.
lines.style: Wry frustration, but not bitter. Self-deprecating humor underneath — she's not taking it too seriously. Slight vocal shrug on 'all night'.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新人さんがお店をうろうろしてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new person kept wandering around the shop earlier.
lines.style: Reflective, observant. Neutral tone — not judging, just noticing. Pace is slower, like she's thinking it over. Trailing off gently at the end, letting Mei draw her own conclusion.
